sources.claim: OmniMux routes legacy compatibility alias jev via channel model_mapping to jev-latest on the embedded official typesafe@1.2.0 task plugin.
Target official alias jev-latest currently resolves to Jev 1.14 (jev-1.14.0).
sources.quote: The most recent stable, official release. The default in our client SDKs, and the name the examples in these docs use.

sources.claim: Underlying model has a default 64k (65536) per-request context and 32k per-question context, expandable to 262k tokens via TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Long-Context: true.
Jev reads natural-language text and PNG/JPEG images.
sources.quote: Jev reads natural-language text, sent as a string, a JSON object, or an array of text values. It also reads PNG and JPEG images anywhere in the request.

sources.claim: TypeSafe charges $0.042 per 1M input tokens ($42 per Btok) and output tokens are free.
sources.quote: You pay per input token. Output tokens are free. A Btok is a billion tokens and an Mtok is a million tokens.

unknowns: alias_target_stability: OmniMux compatibility alias mapped to jev-latest (which moves on new TypeSafe releases); keep jev mapped in channel model_mapping until callers migrate to jev-latest or jev-1.14.0.
max_output_tokens: System One models return structured typed answers rather than free-form token streams and TypeSafe docs publish no max_output_tokens limit.
notes: OmniMux backward-compatibility alias mapped to jev-latest on the embedded official QuantumNous/new-api-plugins typesafe@1.2.0 task plugin (POST /v1/systemone and POST /typesafe/v1/systemone). Resolves jev-latest task billing expression tier("base", u("input_tokens") * 0.042 / 1000000) via ResolveTaskBillingExpr.

notes.zh: 按上游返回用量计费：输入词元 $0.042/百万词元，输出词元免费。
notes.en: Charged by reported usage: input tokens cost $0.042 per 1M tokens; output tokens are free.
